title: Vendor API - Failure Rate
description: ClickHouse-backed failure, timeout, and network-error monitoring by vendor, endpoint, service, and lifecycle stage.

list.name: vendor
list.label: Vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY vendor_id

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events ORDER BY service

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, round(countIf(status IN ('FAILURE', 'TIMEOUT', 'NETWORK_ERROR')) * 100.0 / count(), 2)) AS failure_rate FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service'

SELECT countIf(status IN ('FAILURE', 'TIMEOUT', 'NETWORK_ERROR')) AS failed_calls FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service'

SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, round(countIf(status = 'TIMEOUT') * 100.0 / count(), 2)) AS timeout_rate FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service'

SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, round(countIf(status = 'NETWORK_ERROR') * 100.0 / count(), 2)) AS network_error_rate FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service'

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, vendor_id, if(count() = 0, 0, countIf(status IN ('FAILURE', 'TIMEOUT', 'NETWORK_ERROR')) * 100.0 / count()) AS failure_rate FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' GROUP BY time, vendor_id ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(created_at) AS time, status, count() AS calls FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failure Breakdown By Vendor And Endpoint

targets.rawSql: SELECT vendor_id, endpoint, status, http_status, error_code, count() AS calls, uniqExact(user_id) AS impacted_users, round(avg(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' GROUP BY vendor_id, endpoint, status, http_status, error_code ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT created_at, service, vendor_id, endpoint, status, http_status, latency_ms, error_code, error_message, user_id, loan_application_number, request_id FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status != 'SUCCESS' AND vendor_id LIKE '$vendor' AND service LIKE '$service' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
